full_judgment: 6. Only question calls for determination as to whether patta in favour of plaintiff by her husband is genuine or not. Trial court held that patta is a spurious document as writing of patta has been smeared by soaking and plaintiff failed to prove possession pursuant to the patta. Appellate court in the body of the judgment found that plaintiff possessing the suit land and D.W.1 in his cross-examination admitted that suit property is her own property. P.Ws in their depositions proved patta exhibit-4, P.W.2 proved hand writings of Noor Mohammad Mondal. It is in the evidence that exhibit-4 was exhibited without any objection. Defendant's case is that suit land was not in possession of plaintiff by herself. In our country, it is the go of the day women are shaky in proving that she is in possession of the suit land. Moreover, it is in record that plaintiff is a pordanshin lady. S.A. and R.S. record was prepared in the name of her husband, Noor Mohammad Mondal. Learned Judge of the appellate court considers "Record of right does not create or extinguish the title, it merely raises a presumption of accuracy but the presumption is rebuttable (AIR 1963 Ori. 29; AIR 1968 Pat. 450 at 453). It is no evidence of title, 2 Cal. LJ page 305" Against wrong preparation of record of right, limitation is 6 (six) years for filing suit for declaration, is not applicable when it is proved plaintiffs are in possession for long period.
